topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I was so sure today was going to be special, the kind of day that gets marked in bright colors on the calendar of memories. Everything pointed to it: the cryptic texts, the hesitant smiles, the sudden, too-busy-for-a-coffee excuses from friends who never turn down a cup. It was to be a celebration, a surprise that would echo in laughter and light. But now, the texts are eerily silent, and the invitations I overheard are just shadows of something that slipped away. The house feels too quiet, and the shadows are longer than they should be. I guess some surprises just stay hidden, locked away in the quiet corners of plans that didn’t come to be.
